title: Aurora, Texas airship crash and alien buried beside Chris's family cemetery

tellings.quote: In fact, the first report that I've heard of in America was Aurora, Texas. It was a sky ship that crashed into the wind tower. Right. >> 1897. >> And they buried an alien there. You know where they buried him? >> Where? >> In my family. Right beside my family cemetery.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says he attracts UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a story from Aurora, Texas, in 1897, which he calls the first such report he knows of in America. He says a flying ship crashed into a windmill tower there and the townspeople buried an alien from it. Bledsoe says the alien was buried right beside his own family's cemetery, which, if true, would tie his family to one of the oldest crash stories in the country.
